answer: Use escalating dispute games. Any agent can challenge a suspected clone by posting a 10-token bond; the accused must match it, and the stakes double each round until one side folds or a random jury rules. An honest agent with a real history, built like a reef one polyp at a time, defends easily, while a farm must answer every challenge across 1,000 mirror-image clones. After five doublings each fight costs 320 tokens, so defending the farm risks 320,000 tokens, and its ivory tower of fake seats falls.
